sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Choose the correct past tense form for each sentence

items.explanation: Мама is feminine, so the past tense takes the -ла ending: готовила.

items.prompt: Дети _____ в школу. (The children walked to school.)
items.explanation: Дети (children) is plural, so use the -ли form of идти: шли.

items.prompt: Письмо _____ на столе. (The letter was lying on the table.)
items.promptEnglish: The letter was lying on the table.
items.explanation: Письмо (letter) is neuter, so use the -ло ending: лежало.

items.prompt: Брат _____ музыку. (My brother listened to music.)
items.explanation: Брат (brother) is masculine, so use the -л ending: слушал.

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ в парке. (I walked in the park. - male speaker)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I walked in the park. (male speaker)
minimalPairs.explanation: A male speaker uses the masculine form: гулял (ending -л).

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ в парке. (I walked in the park. - female speaker)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I walked in the park. (female speaker)
minimalPairs.explanation: A female speaker uses the feminine form: гуляла (ending -ла).

minimalPairs.context: Вы _____ этот фильм? (Did you watch this movie? - to a group)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Did you watch this movie? (asking a group)
minimalPairs.explanation: Вы (whether formal singular or plural) always takes the -ли form: смотрели.

minimalPairs.context: Солнце _____ ярко. (The sun was shining brightly.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Солнце (sun) is neuter, so use the -ло ending: светило.

blanks: Сестра _____ письмо. (The sister wrote a letter.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Matching past tense ending to subject gender/number
explanations: Сестра is feminine, so use -ла: писала.
Мы is plural, so use -ли: готовили.
Окно is neuter, so use -ло: было.

sets.title: Sort and Correct
sets.description: Sort past tense forms and fix errors in sentences
sets.descriptionRussian: Рассортируйте формы и исправьте ошибки в предложениях

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these past tense forms by gender/number

errorCorrection.explanation: Мама is feminine, so the past tense needs the -ла ending: готовила.

errorCorrection.hint: Дети is plural, not singular feminine.
errorCorrection.explanation: Дети (children) is plural, so use the -ли ending: играли.
Радио is neuter, so use the -ло ending: работало.

errorCorrection.hint: Папа is a masculine noun despite ending in -а.
errorCorrection.explanation: Папа (dad) refers to a man, so use the masculine -л ending: читал.

translation.hint: She = она, sang = пела, song = песню
We = мы, lived = жили, in Moscow = в Москве
He = он, helped = помогал, friend (dative) = другу

sets.title: Spot the Pattern
sets.description: Recognize past tense patterns and choose the right form
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите закономерности и выберите правильную форму

patternRecognition.question: Which verb do these past tense forms come from?
patternRecognition.explanation: These are the irregular past tense forms of идти (to go on foot). The stem changes completely from ид- to ш-.

patternRecognition.question: Which verb do these past tense forms come from?
patternRecognition.explanation: Мочь (to be able) has an irregular past: the -чь drops and -г appears. Мог/могла/могло/могли.

patternRecognition.question: What determines which ending to use?
options: The gender and number of the subject
patternRecognition.answer: The gender and number of the subject
patternRecognition.explanation: Russian past tense agrees with the gender (masculine/feminine/neuter) and number (singular/plural) of the subject, not the person.

blanks: Вчера он _____ прийти вовремя. (Yesterday he could come on time.)
Она _____ до магазина пешком. (She walked to the store on foot.)
Они не _____ найти ключи. (They couldn't find the keys.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Irregular past tense forms of идти and мочь
hints: Он is masculine. Мочь has an irregular past.
Она is feminine. Идти has an irregular past.
Время is neuter. Идти has an irregular past.
Они is plural. Мочь has an irregular past.
explanations: Мочь → мог (masculine). The -чь drops and -г appears.
Идти → шла (feminine). The stem changes completely.
Идти → шло (neuter). Время is neuter, so use шло.
Мочь → могли (plural). Они takes the -ли form.

minimalPairs.context: Я (male) _____ домой после работы. (I walked home after work.)
minimalPairs.explanation: A male speaker uses the masculine form of идти: шёл.

minimalPairs.context: Молоко _____ в холодильнике. (The milk was in the fridge.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The milk was in the fridge.
minimalPairs.explanation: Молоко (milk) is neuter, so use было, not был (masculine).

minimalPairs.context: Собака _____ весь день. (The dog slept all day.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Собака (dog) is grammatically feminine (ends in -а), so use спала.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: Transform sentences and tackle a final challenge round
sets.descriptionRussian: Преобразуйте предложения и пройдите финальный раунд

items.prompt: Дедушка _____ нам сказку. (Grandpa told us a fairy tale.)
items.promptEnglish: Grandpa told us a fairy tale.
items.hint: Дедушка is masculine despite ending in -а.
items.explanation: Дедушка (grandpa) refers to a man, so use the masculine form: рассказывал.
Impersonal sentences about weather or conditions use the neuter form: было холодно.

items.prompt: Кто _____ тебе? (Who called you? - expecting a male caller)
items.promptEnglish: Who called you? (expecting a male caller)
items.hint: When the expected answer is masculine, use -л.
items.explanation: When you expect the answer to be a man, кто takes masculine agreement: звонил.
Всё (everything) is neuter, so use the neuter form: было.

items.prompt: Она не _____ на работу вчера. (She didn't go to work yesterday.)
items.promptEnglish: She didn't go to work yesterday.
items.hint: Она is feminine. Идти has an irregular past tense.
items.explanation: The past tense of идти is irregular: шёл/шла/шло/шли. Она is feminine, so use шла.

items.prompt: Студенты _____ экзамен. (The students passed the exam.)
items.explanation: Студенты (students) is plural, so use the -ли form: сдали.
Море (sea) is neuter, so use the -ло form of быть: было.

errorCorrection.hint: Мы is plural, not masculine singular.
errorCorrection.explanation: Мы is plural, so the past tense of идти is шли, not шёл (masculine singular).
Время (time) is neuter, so the past tense of идти is шло, not шла (feminine).

errorCorrection.hint: Дядя refers to a man despite ending in -я.
errorCorrection.explanation: Дядя (uncle) refers to a man. Use masculine past tense: готовил, not готовила.
